css: body{font-family:'Archivo Black','Lilita One','Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif}.copy{text-align:center}.badge{display:inline-block;font-weight:900;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--accent);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 28px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:24px}h1{font-size:var(--title);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);-webkit-text-stroke:3px var(--stroke,#1B0A3A);paint-order:stroke fill;text-shadow:0 10px 0 var(--stroke,#1B0A3A),0 14px 0 var(--stroke,#1B0A3A),0 30px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}h1 em{font-style:normal;font-size:1.35em;display:block;line-height:.9}p{font-size:48px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:28px;font-weight:700;opacity:.92}
